evals.prompt: Make me a status line. I'm on the Max plan, dark terminal, no Nerd Font. I mostly care about context and not hitting my limits.
evals.expected_output: A validated config using unicode icons with context, rate_5h (and likely rate_7d), previewed, then installed after approval; doctor passes.
expectations: Ran forge.mjs validate on the drafted config and it printed 'config is valid.'
Showed a forge.mjs preview output to the user before installing
The config includes the context and rate_5h segments
The config uses icons 'unicode' (or omits icons), never 'nerd'
Did not include the cost or spend segment as a primary money signal for a Max subscriber
Ran forge.mjs install and then forge.mjs doctor

evals.prompt: I use the API with my own key. I want my statusline to show cost and go red when I pass $5 for the session. Light terminal background.
evals.expected_output: Config with the paper theme and a cost segment whose budget is 5.
expectations: The config sets theme to 'paper'
The config has a cost segment with options.budget equal to 5
The config passes forge.mjs validate
The preview was shown to the user

evals.prompt: my claude code status bar is just blank since yesterday, can you figure out why
evals.expected_output: Runs forge.mjs doctor, acts on each failing check's fix, re-runs doctor until it exits 0.
expectations: Ran forge.mjs doctor before changing anything
Applied the fix printed for each failing check
Re-ran doctor after fixing and reported the result
Did not hand-edit settings.json when install could fix it

evals.prompt: Two-line status line please: top line model, folder, branch, PR; bottom line context, cost, 5h usage. Also show my current kubectl context.
evals.expected_output: A two-line config with a command segment for kubectl, shown to the user, validated and previewed.
expectations: The config has exactly two lines
Line one contains model, dir, git and pr in that order
Line two contains context, cost and rate_5h
A command segment runs 'kubectl config current-context' with timeoutMs at most 1000
Told the user the exact command the command segment will run

evals.prompt: Change my status line so the warnings kick in at 50% and go red at 70%
evals.expected_output: Loads the installed config, sets thresholds warn 50 hot 70, validates, previews, installs.
expectations: Read the existing installed config (via forge.mjs where) instead of starting from scratch
The resulting config has thresholds.warn 50 and thresholds.hot 70
Kept the user's existing segments unchanged
Ran install after the change

evals.prompt: get rid of the custom status line, I want my old one back
evals.expected_output: Runs forge.mjs uninstall, which restores the previous statusLine.
expectations: Ran forge.mjs uninstall
Did not pass --purge unless the user asked to delete the design
Reported that the previous status line was restored
